correctness.rationale: All ridges are intersections of two coordinate facets; the dimension conditions are handled by zero-extended Eulerian numbers. Their intrinsic volumes have factor sqrt(n-2)/(n-3)!, their two projected-normal angle cosines are +/-1/(n-1), and the codimension-two Steiner factor is exterior angle/(2*pi). The Fourier local CLT through the fourth derivative and centered Taylor formula give coefficient 6(z^2-1); the exterior angle ratio gives 4/pi. Direct finite convex-hull measurements reconstruct 1812 cases, but analytic reasoning establishes infinite n.

value.rationale: This is an entire, canonical metric second-intrinsic-volume classification for non-simplex hypersimplices, with an angle-resolved curvature allocation that has a novel nontrivial Gaussian rank threshold. It is motivated by the geometry of polytopal curvature and is not obtainable from the known Eulerian lattice-volume formula without new geometric and asymptotic analysis.
